facts.value: The Department of Economics offers a joint European Triple-Bachelor in Economics and Business (EU Tribe) with partner universities Solvay Brussels School of Economics & Management and LUISS Rome.
Study in three major European cities, at three renowned universities and obtain degrees from all three participating universities.
Students spend the first year at Goethe University in Frankfurt, followed by a one-year stay in Brussels and another in Rome.
The study in Brussels and Rome can be completed entirely in English.
There is the opportunity to acquire or improve Italian and French language skills.
Interested students initially apply for the Bachelor's in Economics at Goethe University. The application for the Triple-Bachelor program occurs in the first semester.
Admission to the Triple-Bachelor program requires good to very good school performance and English skills at B2 level.
The program is funded through scholarships under the Erasmus+ Program for a maximum of one academic year (260 days).
Tuition fees are waived at both partner universities for participating students.
